mapper.sql: SELECT r.review_id, r.accommodation_id, r.user_id, r.reservation_id, r.rating, r.title, r.content, r.stay_date, r.is_verified, r.status, r.created_at as r_created_at, r.updated_at as r_updated_at, u.username, u.profile_image as user_profile_image_url, a.title as accommodation_title, ri.review_image_id as img_image_id, ri.image_url as img_image_url, ri.upload_order as img_upload_order, ri.created_at as img_ri_created_at, ri.updated_at as img_ri_updated_at FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN review_images ri ON r.review_id = ri.review_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (accommodation_id, user_id, reservation_id, rating, title, content, stay_date, is_verified, status) VALUES (#{accommodationId}, #{userId}, #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{stayDate}, #{isVerified}, #{status})
INSERT INTO review_images (review_id, image_url, upload_order) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{imageUrl}, #{uploadOrder})
mapper.select: WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY ri.upload_order ASC
WHERE r.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, ri.upload_order ASC
WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, ri.upload_order ASC
WHERE a.host_id = #{hostId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, ri.upload_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reviews WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0.0) as avg_rating, COUNT(review_id) as review_count FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0.0) as avg_rating, COUNT(review_id) as review_count FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review_images SET caption = #{caption}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_image_id = #{imageId}
